features.quote: Results showing which conditions most destabilize LLMs could be used to craft adversarial prompts that deliberately degrade model performance.

This experiment's results are easily misread as evidence that LLMs "suffer" or "feel frustrated." The publication and any reports should include explicit framing: we are measuring output properties, not inferring internal states.
